# ORIGEN Healthcare

> Psychiatry, Spravato (esketamine) treatment, primary care, weight loss and HRT, and medical spa treatments in Omaha, Nebraska, for children, teens and adults across Nebraska and Iowa. Provider: Nazira Usmanova, DNP (PMHNP-BC, CPNP-PC, AGNP-BC), a psychiatric nurse practitioner who speaks English, Russian and Farsi.

- Address: 12313 Gold St, Omaha, NE 68144
- Phone: (531) 571-3018; fax (402) 939-0609; email admin@origenhealthcare.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday 9 AM to 5 PM; Saturday by appointment; Sunday closed
- Visits: in person or by telehealth
- Google rating: 4.9 from 55 reviews (November 2026)
- LegitScript certified

## Care

- [Mental Health Treatment in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/mental-health-omaha/): Compassionate psychiatric care for children, adolescents and adults through personalized and evidence-based care.
- [Adult Psychiatry in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/adult-psychiatry-omaha/): Comprehensive psychiatric care for adults experiencing depression, anxiety, mood disorders, and other complex mental health conditions.
- [Child & Adolescent Psychiatry in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/child-psychiatry-omaha/): Specialized mental health care for children and adolescents dealing with emotional challenges, behavioral concerns, or developmental conditions.
- [ADHD Testing & Treatment in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/adhd-treatment/): Professional ADHD evaluations and treatment plans designed to improve attention, focus, behavior, and daily functioning in patients.
- [Autism (ASD) Testing in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/asd-testing/): Comprehensive autism spectrum disorder evaluations to support accurate diagnosis, early intervention, and personalized long-term care planning.
- [Depression Treatment in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/depression-treatment-omaha/): Evidence-based depression treatment designed to help patients improve emotional balance, restore motivation and regain daily functioning.
- [Anxiety Treatment in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/anxiety-treatment-omaha/): Personalized anxiety treatment plans that help patients manage stress, reduce symptoms and improve overall emotional well-being.
- [Mood Disorder Treatment in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/mood-disorder-treatment-omaha/): Specialized care for mood disorders including bipolar disorder and related conditions affecting emotional stability and daily life.
- [PTSD Treatment in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/ptsd-treatment-omaha/): Comprehensive treatment options for post-traumatic stress disorder that help patients manage symptoms and improve emotional stability.
- [Personality Disorder Treatment in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/personality-disorder-treatment/): Professional psychiatric care for personality disorders that affect relationships, emotional regulation, and everyday functioning.
- [Postpartum Counseling in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/postpartum-counseling/): Mental health support for mothers experiencing postpartum depression, anxiety, or emotional challenges after childbirth.
- [PMDD Treatment in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/pmdd-treatment-omaha/): Specialized treatment for premenstrual dysphoric disorder helping patients manage severe mood changes and emotional symptoms.
- [PMS Treatment in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/pms-treatment-omaha/): Personalized care for premenstrual syndrome focusing on mood changes, stress management, and overall emotional well-being.
- [Insomnia Treatment in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/insomnia-treatment/): Professional treatment for sleep disorders helping patients improve sleep quality and restore healthy daily routines.
- [Psychiatric Evaluation in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/psychiatric-evaluation-omaha/): Comprehensive evaluations for children, adolescents and adults: the first step to the right care.
- [Medication Management in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/medication-management-omaha/): Follow-up care that adjusts your medicines with you, with side effects taken seriously.
- [Russian & Farsi-Speaking Psychiatric Care in Omaha](https://origenhealthcare.com/russian-farsi-speaking-psychiatric-care/): Talk about your health in your own language: care in English, Russian and Farsi.
- [Spravato Treatment in Omaha, NE for Treatment-Resistant Depression](https://origenhealthcare.com/spravato-treatment-omaha/): If traditional antidepressants haven’t worked, Spravato® treatment may help. Medically supervised in our Omaha clinic.
- [Spravato® Cost & Insurance in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/spravato-cost-insurance-omaha/): What Spravato® may cost, how insurance coverage works and how our team helps you check it.
- [Do I Qualify for Spravato®?](https://origenhealthcare.com/do-i-qualify-for-spravato/): A short checklist for treatment-resistant depression, and how the evaluation works.
- [Your First Spravato® Session: What to Expect](https://origenhealthcare.com/first-spravato-session/): Before, during and after a Spravato® visit: a step-by-step guide.

- [Morpheus8 Treatment in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/morpheus8-treatment-omaha/): Advanced radiofrequency microneedling treatment that aims to tighten skin, refine texture and encourage collagen production.
- [PRP Microneedling in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/prp-microneedling-omaha/): PRP microneedling treatment designed to improve skin texture, reduce fine lines, and promote natural skin rejuvenation.
- [HydraFacial in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/hydrafacial-omaha/): Deep cleansing facial treatment that hydrates skin, removes impurities, and improves overall skin tone and appearance.
- [Laser Hair Removal in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/laser-hair-removal-omaha/): Advanced laser hair removal treatment designed to reduce unwanted hair over a series of sessions.
- [Laser Tattoo Removal in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/laser-tattoo-removal-omaha/): Professional laser tattoo removal treatment that gradually fades unwanted tattoos using advanced laser technology over a series of sessions.
- [PRP Treatment for Hair in Omaha, NE](https://origenhealthcare.com/prp-treatment-for-hair-omaha/): Platelet-rich plasma hair treatment that aims to support hair growth and scalp health.

- [Weight Loss & HRT](https://origenhealthcare.com/weight-loss-hormone-replacement-therapy/): Hormone replacement therapy for menopausal symptoms, premature ovarian insufficiency, hypogonadism and low testosterone, plus medical weight loss.
